title: Colored operator presentations and explicit coherent operation systems
statement:
Use the simplicial sets, coherent functor categories, equivalences and mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the degreewise fibers and cocartesian edges of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], the symmetric infinity-operad and relative-algebra definitions of [def-coef-relative-symmetric-operadic-algebras], and coherent fiber transport characterized by IsCocartesianTransport in [lem-coef-cocartesian-section-colimits]. Fix a sufficiently large universe and a color set C. A colored operator presentation is a category on finite labeled tuples (including the empty tuple), with its arity functor to Fin_*, symmetric infinity-operad nerve, and specified inert projections to the singleton labels. An operation is an active arrow from an input tuple to one output color. A rooted leveled tree is an active chain of operators ending at a singleton; tree shapes also include inert diagrams. A tree face is a simplicial restriction of such a shape. A coherent inert pruning is a diagram Delta[m] times Delta[r] in the operator nerve whose rows are tree faces and whose vertical edges are inert. A forest decomposition is a family of rooted output trees with the indicated output colors and inert pruning diagrams from a given forest, omitting external wires outside each output's ancestors; this is an index for reconstruction, not a primitive value of the data.

For q:E to N(O^tensor), the inert fiber Segal condition says that actual cocartesian projection transports give an equivalence from each tuple fiber to the product of its singleton fibers, including the empty product. A transport frame specifies active-operation transports, inert projection transports, their coherent cocartesian lifts with the stated sources, targets and base edges, and these Segal equivalences. Given a frame T and any simplicial parameter K, a coherent colored-operation system has a diagram x_c:K to E_c for each color; a tuple-fiber realization for each input tuple with equivalences from its inert projections to the color diagrams; a coherent arrow T_theta(tuple) to x_d in the target singleton fiber for every active single-output operation; comparison diagrams over rooted trees and inert shapes; and coherent diagrams over inert prunings of their faces. Tree faces and pruning faces agree on every common simplicial restriction over the same base diagram. Tree vertices are the tuple realizations, and total edges over inert operators and vertical pruning edges are q-cocartesian. For each operation, a triangle over (theta,id) has the specified tree edge as its long edge, the fixed transport lift as its first edge, and the specified target-fiber arrow as its second edge. Analogous triangles for inert projections identify the Segal equivalences with the actual inert tree edges. Thus the fiber arrows are tied to their total arrows and coherences; there is no independent total-space value indexed by every general multi-output forest.

Precomposition in K gives real reindexing maps. The simplicial set coloredOperationData has these systems with K=Delta[n] as its n-simplices. Its literal coordinate map retains the color, tree, and pruning diagrams and forgets their transport-factorization choices. Literal restriction of an inert-preserving relative section is evaluation at colors and precomposition by exactly these tree and pruning base diagrams. The canonical restriction correspondence is the pullback of these two coordinate maps; a representative restriction functor must induce exactly the literal coordinate restriction. General forest values and outputwise arrows are reconstructed from the tree data using the Segal comparisons, rather than supplied as extra independent coordinates. No limit, colimit, presentability, or nonempty-color hypothesis is made.

source.place: Higher Algebra (2017), Construction 2.1.1.7 and the paragraphs following it, Definition 2.1.1.10, Remark 2.1.1.17, Example 2.1.1.21, Definition 2.1.3.1 and Remark 2.1.3.4. Rooted leveled-tree, inert-pruning and target-fiber coordinates expand the coherent colored-operation data in the reconstruction node.

lean.note: Color-indexed fiber objects, target-fiber operation arrows against fixed cocartesian lifts, rooted-tree and inert-pruning coherences, and Segal tuple realizations. The literal restriction maps define a canonical pullback correspondence; general forests are reconstructed outputwise, not stored independently.

Identity-normalization clause checked consistent (factorization forces color d = tuple(singleton d)). Fix: fixes/ColoredOperationSectionReconstruction.lean changes the conclusion to `Nonempty (ColoredTransportFrame O q) ∧ ∀ T, <same clauses>` and updates the docstring; no other change. nt_compile.py --json with both siblings: delivered and fixed versions exit 0 with no diagnostics; a broken-variant check confirms errors are reported.
